newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA FINANCE SECTOR 1H PROFITS UP 47 PCT.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA FINANCE SECTOR 1H PROFITS UP 47 PCT.

text.p: BOGOTA, Aug 13 Reuter - Colombia's financial sector posted combined first-half net profits of 231.8 billion pesos, a 47 percent rise compared with 156.9 billion pesos in the same period last year, according to local media reports.
The first-half profits did not include the results of state- run financial institutions Caja Agraria, IFI and BCH.

Preliminary reports by the Bank Superintendency show that first-half profits, including the state-run entities rose 56 percent to 430 billion pesos against 275 billion earned in the same period last year.
The total assets of the financial sector stood at more than 31 trillion pesos at the end of the first half of 1997 compared with 26 trillion in the first-half of last year.
